title: Annoying Squeaks and Irritating Features
summary: This topic is dominated by complaints about annoying squeaks from the seat or braking and other irritating usability restrictions such as alerts, lighting, drive modes, and paid features.

positive.summary: Positive reviews are not clearly about this topic, with one fragment only negating annoyance and another preferring a different tourer.

negative.summary: Negative reviews consistently describe annoying squeaks and frustrating feature behavior involving the seat, braking, speed alerts, lighting, drive modes, stopping or moving off, and paid options.

mixed.summary: The mixed review contrasts a previous tourer with this one and says the removal of a feature is extremely annoying.

undetermined.summary: The undetermined review mentions a seat squeak but does not provide enough context to confirm the sentiment beyond the issue description.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes several unrelated annoyances, including squeaks, driver-assistance behavior, lighting controls, paid options, and drive-mode usability.
Positive evidence is sparse and not clearly focused on satisfaction with this topic.
Many fragments are brief and lack detail about the underlying component or situation.
